Qatar Development Bank (QDB) has announced a new investment in Multiverse Computing to accelerate artificial‑intelligence research and development within the country. The partnership is intended to strengthen Qatar’s AI ecosystem, fostering innovation and positioning the nation as a competitive player on the global tech stage. The announcement was reported by the Qatar Tribune and summarized through Google News aggregation.
